tbesh_html:
1) to dissolve, melt
1a) (Qal) to waste away
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to melt, vanish, drop off, melt away
1b2) to faint, grow fearful (fig.)
1b3) wasted, worthless (participle)
1c) (Hiphil) to cause to melt

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to liquefy; figuratively, to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: discourage, faint, be loosed, melt (away), refuse, [idiom] utterly.
